definitions.gloss: to have more than one can handle; to not know what to do with
definitions.explanation: to find something too much to deal with or manage, often leading to neglect

examples.japanese: ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{持|も}て{余|あま}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I have time on my hands.

examples.japanese: ⟦{体力|たいりょく}→体力：05318_tairyoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{持|も}て{余|あま}す⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧な⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧だ。
examples.english: The energetic child has more energy than they know what to do with.

examples.japanese: {広|ひろ}すぎる⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{持|も}て{余|あま}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: They don't know what to do with such a large house.

notes:
{持|も}て{余|あま}す describes having something that is too much to handle or use effectively.

VERB TYPE:
- Godan verb (す-verb)
- Transitive

ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦{持|も}てる→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ (potential of ⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to hold) + ⟦{余|あま}す→余す：27283_amasu⟧ (to have left over)
- Literally: to have excess of what one can hold

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{持|も}て{余|あま}す (to have time on one's hands)
- ⟦{体力|たいりょく}→体力：05318_tairyoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{持|も}て{余|あま}す (to have excess energy)
- ⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{持|も}て{余|あま}す (to waste one's talent)
- ⟦{暇|ひま}→暇：00592_hima⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{持|も}て{余|あま}す (to not know what to do with free time)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- Often used with abstract nouns (time, energy, talent)
- Can describe both positive (too much talent) and negative (can't handle) situations
- {持|も}て{余|あま}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ is very common (ongoing state)

USAGE:
- Implies slight frustration or inability to utilize fully
- Different from simply "having extra" - implies a burden or waste
- Often used for things that should be useful but are not being used well

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{暇|ひま}→暇：00592_hima⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つぶす (to kill time)
- ⟦{使|つか}い{切|き}れない→使い切る：11518_tsukaikiru⟧ (can't use up)
- ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{余|あま}る→余る：00001_amaru⟧ (to be beyond one's ability)

REGISTER: Neutral. Common in everyday conversation.
